hook: JWST finds 39 brown dwarf candidates in IC 348
what_happened: Luhman and Alves de Oliveira used JWST NIRCam and NIRSpec to identify 39 candidates, 15 spectra, nine confirmed substellar members
why_it_matters: Shows the lowest mass brown dwarfs (~2 M_Jup) exist, tightening the IMF minimum and revealing planet‑forming disks
the_catch: Only 15 of 39 candidates got spectra (NIRSpec's mask covers a limited field); mass estimates below ~0.05 M☉ lack dynamical tests.
caption: Newly discovered brown dwarfs push the limits of star‑formation science.
alt_text: Five-slide text carousel on flat colour fields, no photographs. Sky-blue hook slide: 'JWST finds 39 brown dwarf candidates in IC 348'. Cream slide describing the NIRCam and NIRSpec survey. Pink slide on why it matters. Dark slide stating the catch. Closing sky-blue slide with the @gummietech handle and the source credit.
attribution: Luhman and Alves de Oliveira, The Astrophysical Journal Letters (2025)

es.hook: JWST encuentra 39 candidatos a enanas marrones en IC 348
es.what_happened: Luhman y Alves de Oliveira usaron JWST NIRCam y NIRSpec para identificar 39 candidatos, 15 espectros, nueve miembros subestelares confirmados
es.why_it_matters: Muestra que existen enanas marrones de menor masa (~2 M_Jup), estrechando el mínimo del IMF y revelando discos formadores de planetas
es.the_catch: Solo 15 de los 39 candidatos obtuvieron espectros (la máscara de NIRSpec cubre un campo limitado); las estimaciones de masa por debajo de ~0.05 M☉ carecen de pruebas dinámicas
